sources.section:  <u>HOME SCREEN CONTINUED:</u> > <u>Career Intelligence section on Home screen:</u>
sources.quote:
**<u>Salary Index:</u>** 

1. All of the amounts listed under each country are showing 3 digit (100k) monthly salaries.  Has the salary source information being linked yet? 

2. There is no India – do we need to add this?  I believe Yes

sources.source_id: taleer - test flight feedback from andi 24.08.26.pdf
sources.quote:
**<u>Touching the profile picture for Menu:</u>** 

1. **Notifications bell** :  Seems to be working 

2. **My profile.** We need to allow user to add a selfie picture from their camera phone, or upload a picture, as well as pull any picture from their linked in profile.  Also when you select your nationality – its too slow to populate your country and then we need a back button that takes you back to the home screen.  When you save your nationality – it then keeps you stuck on the page, unless you press the taleer logo. 

If I change nationality (I tried to change to Russia, US) it wouldn’t change.  The flag remained the same.   Evetually, if I move around the app, I know I have changed to Russian (because the visa guide told me, but the flag didn’t appear). 

Also, we need to ensure that all nationalities then trigger the right information (visa information for Visa guide section etc). 

3. **My Applications:** Not working. Doesn’t take me through to the section.  Then the whole app freezes!.  The only way to move forward is to close the app and start again. 

**4. Settings:** Not working 

**5. Plans & Billings:** Not working 

**6. Help & Support:** Not working 

**7. Privacy & Data:** Not working 

8. **Terms of Service:** It opens to the terms, but when you press the “back to taleer button” – it takes you through to the Taleer website (taleer.ai) and the waitlist form – this is a major fault.  It should take you back to the home screen and not the taleer.ai website.  I think this is because you have linked the terms from the website. 

9. **Privacy Policy:** Same as  Terms of service:  It takes you back to the Taleer.ai website and not the home screen.

sources.source_id: taleer - test flight feedback from andi 24.08.26.pdf
sources.quote:
**<u>Search Criteria:</u>** 

1. **Industry drop down:** When you touch the industry button, it takes you to preferred industry, scrolling is fine, but if you try to type an industry under search, the search field is pushed to the top of the screen and you can’t see what you are typing until you start typing.  Let’s make sure the search button allows the user to see what they are typing and remains on the screen – line of sight.  If I type in manually an industry – it does not populate any answer back on the search criteria page. 

**Also the list of industries – do we have enough, and do they match the industries that we are scrapping from both the companies and Decodo/Linkedin?** 

2. **Job Title:** Same as industry drop down – if I try to type, the search bar goes off screen until I type something.  The list of job titles is too small (for each industry).   If I type in manually an industry – it does not populate any answer back on the search criteria page. We need to allow manual selections to appear and then be used for when scrapping for a role. 

3. **Location:** Currently this is an Open field.  Lets change it to a drop down only of the countries that we are offering (UAE, Oman, Bahrain, Kuwait, Qatar, Saudi, Lebanon, Jordan, Egypt & India).  This way, we only keep the countries and improve the UI for this. 

Also if they select India, we then only allow for Tech/IT for the Industry drop down. 

4. **Salary Expectations:** This seems fine. 

I tried a search for Automotive and then entering multiple roles (manually):  Chief Transformation Officer, Managing Director and network manager. 

there are not enough Job titles, and trying to add a title in manually, didn’t allow it to populate to the smart home screen.  We need to urgently look at this, also ensuring that any job that can be entered manually is included in the search (data scrapping) 

**<u>Jobs Matched to your Criteria:</u>** 

1. **Search Criteria:** Job The number of jobs listed seems to linked to industry (total count of jobs in that industry).  Even when I changed the  job title from the list, it didn’t change the total number of jobs, it only gave me a total from that industry.  Then I added another industry and pressed done.  Then no changes to the total (from the counter).  Despite adding another industry – the total number of jobs remained the same.   It only changes when I go into “start your search” and then come back to the home screen, only then does the counter change.    Even Location does filter down the number of jobs.  It appears that only Industry seems to be the main filter for total count.  Is this by purpose?

sources.source_id: taleer - test flight feedback from andi 24.08.26.pdf
sources.quote:
2. **Your Matches:** The list of jobs is shown fine (in order of match which is good).  If you save the job – it works and add to the STAGE 1 Home page counter as saved. If you press the tailor your CV and apply, it seems to be fine and takes you through to the URL (I did 3 examples and it took me though to LinkedIn job applications), however, its very slow.  Take over 20 – 30 seconds for major changes. 

3. Home screen for stage 1 – dashboard total 

When clicking on the Interview (the jobs that you have applied for are listed).  Please add function of being able to convert to interview against the job.  Add a button next to job –“going for interview”
